sourcePolicy: Use the earliest committed AVIF rendition as the stable surviving source. Preserve that source and every current site asset byte-for-byte; write a new archival derivative only.
selectionMethod: Prioritize photographic, non-UI portfolio assets with very low surviving encoded bits per pixel, visible tonal or detail weakness, and meaningful case-study use. Text-heavy UI and identity composites are excluded because neural super-resolution can invent lettering.

pipeline.decode: ImageMagick 7, lossless 16-bit sRGB PNG transport at native source dimensions
pipeline.reconstruction: HardMagic GPU inference service, RealESRGAN x4plus, native source dimensions, internal 512-pixel tiling, 4x output
pipeline.finishing: Lanczos resample to a 7,680-pixel long edge with restrained unsharp compensation; no crop, denoise, recolor, face repair, inpaint, ControlNet, IPAdapter, or diffusion
pipeline.disclosure: Generative reconstruction used. RealESRGAN is GAN-based super-resolution and infers plausible high-frequency detail; these derivatives are enhanced presentation masters, not forensic originals.

assets.selectionReason: Lowest surviving information density among photographic portfolio assets and visibly crushed low-light detail.

metrics.reconstruction: RealESRGAN x4plus to 3520x3668, then archival Lanczos finishing to a 7680-pixel long edge

assets.selectionReason: Second-lowest surviving photographic information density with weak fine texture and compressed highlight transitions.
Low-bitrate panoramic hero with visible edge softness and banding risk across a highly prominent tonal gradient.
